name: triage-opened
description: A new issue from an issue form, an audit or the Sentry sweep carries `status: triage`; the triage workflow reproduces it at HEAD and routes it (ADR 0014). The claim stands down when the `<!-- agent-triage -->` marker is already there.

name: triage-relabel
description: A human adds `run: triage` to (re)triage an issue; bypasses the already-triaged marker. Issues a run holds or that wait for a human never match.

name: implement
description: A human adds `run: implement` to a ready ticket; the implement-ticket workflow claims it (ADR 0014). Tickets already held, in review, or PRDs never match.
